positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Official mentor for team Intern and Apprentice
- Implementing Global Treasury's Stablecoin settlement platform with Java/Spring, Apache Kafka, Angular, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes.
- Led a full stack application project that supports Visa’s Settlement operations among other entry level developers by designing the system and holding weekly code review calls.
- Automated Docker container deployment process utilizing Jenkins and enterprise APIs, automating numerous hours of manual work
- Migrated enterprise application file storage from NAS to AWS S3
- Migrated IBM mainframe/DB2 application flows to modern software (React, Java/Spring Boot and Batch) as microservices, including Visa’s Mexico national net settlement service
- Skills: Java, Spring Boot/Batch, Kafka, Angular, React, Redux, MySQL, Docker, AWS
positions.insights: Skills: Java · MySQL · Amazon S3 · Kubernetes · React.js · Spring Framework · Apache Kafka · AngularJS · Docker · Stablecoin · Payment Systems
